assignment.description: A building-unlock or tier-upgrade card placed into an offer slot. All three keys are always present even when tier_index is semantically unused (kind: unlock always keys off tier 0s card art).

building_type.description: The RESEARCH/tiers_unlocked key from buildings.json building_type (TimelinePLAN D3) e.g. "defence".

kind.description: unlock = this building types initial research card (game/buildings/research.py unlock_group semantics); tier = a tier-upgrade card for an already-unlocked type.

tier_index.description: 0-2, indexing into that building types 3 tiers. Semantically unused (always 0) when kind is unlock.

level.description: One player village_level and the offer slots authored for the level-up at that level.

offer_slots.description: The offer slots for this level-up. An empty, still-persisted slot (assignment: null) is a legitimate saved state, not just a transient UI affordance. Cardinality is dynamic per level-up, editable directly in the Timeline UI.

round.description: The round at the END of which this village_level is reached, when Timeline.scripted_leveling is true. Ignored for village_level 1 (the run starts there) and ignored entirely while scripted_leveling is false.

village_level.description: The RunState.village_level this level-up fires at (1-based, incremented once per level-up).

offer_slot.description: One drag-and-drop target square on the Timeline. Wraps a nullable assignment object (rather than making the array item itself nullable) so a future per-slot metadata field has somewhere to land without reshaping the array.

assignment.description: The building/tier card placed in this slot, or null for an empty slot.

description: Progression balancing domain (TimelinePLAN D1): the Timeline editor authors which building unlock/tier-upgrade cards are eligible offer-slot choices at each player village_level level-up. This is the sole source of unlock-timing eligibility (replaces buildings.json unlock_min_round, TimelinePLAN D4/T4). Two independent designer switches sit on Timeline itself: scripted_leveling (WHEN each level is reached — authored rounds instead of XP) and exact_offer_slots (WHAT a level-up shows — the row's exact card set instead of an eligibility floor). Both default false; with both false the runtime behaves exactly as it did before they existed. Bounds policy: village_level 1-1000 and round 0-1000 (matches the repo rounds/levels bounds policy), tier_index 0-2 (one of a building type's 3 tiers).

exact_offer_slots.description: When true a level's offer_slots are the EXACT card set that level-up shows: an empty (null) slot becomes a +Love card, an already-claimed card is dropped, and duplicate placements across levels are allowed. False = the shipped behaviour, where a row only marks which cards become ELIGIBLE from that village_level on.

levels.description: Sparse, one entry per player village_level that has at least one authored offer slot. A village_level with no entry has no manually curated slots.

scripted_leveling.description: When true the player's village level follows the authored per-level round schedule instead of XP: the level-up fires at ROUND_END of each level's round, XP is never awarded (no XP bar, no XP floaters), and a level with no authored row never fires. False = the shipped XP-threshold behaviour, unchanged.

title: progression
